hypothesis: A finite decoder-visible suffix quotient trained from mature batch-1 NNCP distributions can retain at least 2100 B/M net in the native reversible symbol domain while beating an equal-capacity hard-label control.
interfaces_exposed: NNCP reversible u16be symbols; static dyadic context tables; exact arithmetic payload
kill_condition: Retire this suffix-quotient family if the frozen soft student fails to beat the matched hard-label control or is below 2100 B/M net on either population; do not open a depth, denominator, or table-cap ladder.
promotion_condition: On frozen chronological and distant mature traces, exact student arithmetic bytes plus compressed model bytes save at least 2100 B/M and beat the matched hard-label control; native encode/decode is deterministic and exact.
rejection_reason: The exact 1K same-domain gate found no two-part soft win: payload lost 99-187 bytes and total lost 241-9881 bytes to matched hard-label controls across frozen depths 0,1,2. Retire suffix centroids without a ladder.
title: Same-domain quantized NNCP soft-quotient student
